description: This file defines a PHP trait 'TimesheetPermissionTrait' that provides permission checking functionality for timesheet access control within the OrangeHRM application. It includes a method to verify if a given timesheet is accessible based on user roles and ownership, and throws exceptions if access is denied or if used incorrectly.

methods.name: checkTimesheetAccessible
methods.description: Checks if the provided timesheet is accessible based on user roles and ownership. Throws ForbiddenException if not accessible, or LogicException if the trait is used outside of the Endpoint context.
